name: Dwarf
summary: Stout folk of stone and forge with 120-ft Darkvision, poison resilience, extra Hit Points and Tremorsense.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in Dim Light within 120 feet as if it were Bright Light, and in Darkness as if it were Dim Light.
traits.text: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.summary: Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saves to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.
traits.text: You have Resistance to Poison damage, and you have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.summary: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1 per character level.
traits.text: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again every time you gain a level.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.summary: Bonus Action, PB times per Long Rest: Tremorsense 60 ft for 10 minutes while on or touching stone.
traits.text: As a Bonus Action, you gain Tremorsense with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes. The Tremorsense works only while you are on a stone surface or touching one; the stone can be natural or worked. You can use this Bonus Action a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus and regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
